content: Hi how can i assist you today
Shopping sites recommend the exact items I’m silently considering. It feels beyond normal suggestions.
Recommendations pull from browse history, cart views, and similar users’ behavior. Were those items on any previous wishlists or comparison pages?
I had viewed them last week and similar brands yesterday.
That would feed the model. If you open a private window with no sign-in and browse the same category, the recommendations usually look more generic.
In private mode I saw unrelated picks.
That contrast points to account and history signals rather than thought-based selection.
